steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each score must quote its evidence, and the transcript must be free of personal data.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Transcript with personal data not removed
findings.fix: Remove the personal data before sharing

findings.title: Score with no quoted evidence
findings.fix: Quote the line the score rests on

findings.title: Score that does not follow from the quote

outcome.notChecked: Interactions not sampled; the customer's outcome.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks a score with no quoted evidence, a score that does not follow from the quote, and a transcript with personal data not removed.
cons: Not checked: Interactions not sampled; the customer's outcome.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-cs-quality-assurance skill on the records for this review.
